blocks.name: Super Saiyan Vegeta (golden hair, green eyes) - playable fighter

paletteShared.#000000: every outline and the baked ground shadow
paletteShared.#ad7b39: darkest hair shade / hair outline and a skin shade - recolour it only inside the hair region
paletteShared.#737373: the outline of the armour, gloves and boots
paletteShared.#c6c6c6: eye whites, armour, gloves and boots
paletteShared.#ffffff: hair highlights, eye whites, armour/glove/boot highlights and white effects

blocks.notes: Cells are 32x32 on alternating solid checker cells #47ffbb/#34bc88; the sheet surround is #2a966c with a #237f5a border - treat all four as transparent. The RIGHT row is a pixel-exact horizontal mirror of the LEFT row in every column except the flight cells. Same layout as vegeta.png for columns 0-50. Row lengths: down 57 cells (0-56), left/right 55 (0-54), up 51 (0-50) with up col 1 empty. Order: 0 idle, 1 blink, 2-5 walk, 6-9 run, 10-13 / 14-17 / 18-21 the three melee strings (wind-up, hit, follow-through, recover; the third string is the kick, so punch3 and kick share 18-21), 22-27 leaping somersault strike used as the charged melee (22 crouch, 23 leap with arm thrown up, 24 tuck, 25 somersault with a white arc, 26 diving strike landing with an arc, 27 low landing stance), 28-30 one-hand ki blast (28 fist drawn back, 29 palm thrust, 30 full extension), 31-34 ki sweep (31 blue ki swirl gathers on the rear hand, 32 swept forward as a big blue crescent, 33 crescent follows through low, 34 fades), 35 hurt flinch with a white hit spark at the head, 36-37 crossed-arm X-block (36 carries a small block spark, 37 is the held pose), 38 chest-out power-up stance (near-idle; the engine aura makes it read), 39-42 Vegeta's arms-folded pose with a curl of steam rising above his head (looping) - he has no arms-raised pose, so raise uses it as his victory/confident pose, 43-46 swimming (head and arms above the waterline, no baked shadow), 47-50 flying (no baked shadow), 51-54 knocked out on the side rows (51 stagger, 52 thrown back, 53 flat, 54 settled). The down row only has 51 (stagger) and 52 (thrown back, arms over the head) for the knockout, exposed as 'koFront'. 'ko' sets shadow "keep": on the lying frames 53-54 the shadow finder would strip the black closed-eye lines of the face; the cost is the baked ground shadow staying under the two short fall frames 51-52. On this sheet the knockout reverts him: side-row 51 is golden, 52 pale brown, 53 dark brown-black and 54 black base-form hair, so a KO ends in base form. Cells with no baked shadow: 23-25 (airborne leap), 43-50 (swim, fly), down-row 12/16/33 (trail or ki arc drawn over the ground). Down-only 53-56 is the standing SSJ-to-base power-down ('revert': golden with eyes shut, pale, brown, black). FLIGHT IS DIAGONAL: row 0 = flying down-right toward the camera, row 1 = down-left, row 2 = up-left (back view), row 3 = up-right (back view); row 0 mirrors row 1 and row 3 mirrors row 2. So 'fly' omits right: mirror the left frames (that is exactly row 0); the row-2 frames are kept as 'flyUpLeft'. outfit = blue bodysuit; outfit2 = white armour and gloves; trim = the olive-gold shoulder straps and belt (extra key). Hair recolour (e.g. Blue/God palettes): #e7a542, #ffff39 and #ffffbd are hair-only; #ad7b39 (hair outline, also a skin shade) and #ffffff (hair highlight, also eye whites and armour) are listed in paletteShared and should be recoloured only inside the hair region. The baked ground shadow is #000000 (outline colour) - strip it by geometry. Baked effects: white swoosh trails 11-21 and 25-26, sparkles 35-36, blue ki 31-34, steam curl 39-42.
